title: The Game I Am Hoping Redefines AI Slop And Web Games
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
This is a web game. I just need to polish **the people (people is the last graphical item)** and a few things inside the gameplay but its its pretty done and the goal of this game is to redefine both achieving high quality and performance in a web game.

The game has three modes:

* **Story Mode:** You play as the narrator
* **City Builder:** Where you you can build your own city and defend it from the Martians
* **Martian Vanguard:** Where you play as the martians must capture humans be tactical with the flying machine and handling machines

# Technical Goal

  
From a technical perspective, this all ThreeJS, all custom built assets (nothing bought), and has an highly interactive open world. I am **1 month and about 1 week in making this.**

A lot of the learning that went into making this game AI Gaming Festival, including how its going to be distributed and the prompt sequencs.

The goal is push boundaries of a web game because one really highly quality web games come out, it will change distribution, especially around app stores and their need to be gatekeepers.

comments.author: daddywookie
comments.body:
The first screen looks absolutely 100% AI styled. The subtle orange shading to everything, the typography, the excessive use of short tag lines all over the place.

It's great that you have incredibly high confidence, lord knows you need that as a solo developer, but you need to ground it a little. Have you done any public playtesting at all? Have you tested this with friends and family? Have you got any feedback on the visuals and gameplay from genre fans?

Its sad that baseline graphic design has become “ai slop” definition now we will need to redefine what is neat legible design again I think it’s beige palette Claude pumps out often that has created this new feel of Swiss graphic design but with serif type equals ai I don’t think the game looks intimidating from a vibe coded game like oh no I better get better but it doesn’t look like full on trash like many of the comments suggest. The comments sound overly harsh, I wonder how honest the OP is with all the info they have shared because this sounds almost too good to be true
